policies.Nefarian: Actual known current opponent hero class, complete host ordinary collectible spell domain and replacement selection for two cards. Current neutral hero receives two named Tail Swipes; unknown class is an explicit error.
policies.Barista: Capture other active friendly current Battlecry-capable minions before first copy; ordinary printed-base hand copies with complete original material, no original movement or copied Battlecry.
policies.Jepetto: Two physical matching minion draw slots; existing whole-group set-stats-cost1 reward on original valid hand arrivals.
policies.Yrel: Inspect all current physical own-deck card classes, unknown metadata is an error; no Neutral qualifies including empty deck, then captured original minion receives four ordinary keyword grants.
policies.Kiri: Ordinary named Solar Eclipse then Lunar Eclipse hand deliveries; both complete existing definitions remain exact.
policies.Shekzara: Existing own-deck genuine discovery samples up to three distinct card IDs. On selection freeze every original matching physical deck reference, draw the selected one as the actual discovery delivery, then remaining original copies in deck order. No unrelated/newly shuffled copies or fabricated draws.
policies.Tenwu: Original friendly non-self active minion return, printed reset and cost1 installed before returned/hand-entry reactions with actual current-turn expiry. Full-hand return remains ordinary death without a successful hand price.
policies.Deathwing: Existing original physical all-other-minion attack continuation, dynamic active candidates and ordinary forced combat; each original residence attempted once, stops when original attacker is no longer eligible.
policies.Varden: Capture original active enemy group and initial frozen flags; freeze nonfrozen originals first, then ordinary four-damage minion-ability batch to initially frozen originals, without Spell Damage.
policies.Cariel: Actual own attack declaration, current original hand Holy spell references, ordinary permanent minus1 local cost; no other attacker, non-Holy spell or minion discount.
policies.Hobart: Accept only a real current equipped weapon; capture all own HAND/DECK minions before first ordinary plus2/plus2, do not buff board or later arrivals.

uncertainties: Nefarian current neutral-hero Tail Swipe policy is supported by community notes that conflict with historical official statements; precise CN behavior remains unverified.
Barista base-copy mode and current Battlecry/silence/granted-capability qualification are explicit local policy. No separate copied attachment semantics are invented.

Shekzara distinct definition offers, selection-time frozen copy inventory, selected-first delivery and discovery notification before remaining draws are explicit local policies pending CN timing evidence.
Tenwu original controller destination, reset, expiry/return notification and full-hand death use the existing return/cost policies; exact cross-reaction boundaries remain deferred.
Deathwing fresh attack order and original residence tracking, Varden freeze-before-damage and group reaction windows, and Holy cost/buff target capture retain existing local policies.
Complete original past source, formal standard eligibility, patch/hotfix alignment and all other goal domains remain open.
